#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# --- Configuration ---
DOCX_FILE="docs/customer_report.docx"
RECIPIENT="bob@example.com"
SUBJECT="Customer Report"
BODY="Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached.\n\nBest regards"

# --- Validate input ---
if [[ ! -f "$DOCX_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Error: '$DOCX_FILE' not found." >&2
    exit 1
fi

PDF_FILE="${DOCX_FILE%.docx}.pdf"
OUTDIR="$(dirname "$DOCX_FILE")"

# --- Step 1: Convert DOCX to PDF ---
echo "Converting '$DOCX_FILE' to PDF..."

if command -v libreoffice &>/dev/null; then
    libreoffice --headless --convert-to pdf "$DOCX_FILE" --outdir "$OUTDIR"
elif command -v pandoc &>/dev/null; then
    pandoc "$DOCX_FILE" -o "$PDF_FILE"
else
    echo "Error: No converter found. Install libreoffice or pandoc." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f "$PDF_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Error: PDF was not created." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "PDF created: $PDF_FILE"

# --- Step 2: Email the PDF ---
echo "Emailing '$PDF_FILE' to $RECIPIENT..."

if command -v mutt &>/dev/null; then
    echo -e "$BODY" | mutt -s "$SUBJECT" -a "$PDF_FILE" -- "$RECIPIENT"
elif command -v mail &>/dev/null; then
    echo -e "$BODY" | mail -s "$SUBJECT" -A "$PDF_FILE" "$RECIPIENT"
elif command -v msmtp &>/dev/null; then
    # msmtp requires a fully formed MIME message; fall back to a simple approach
    {
        echo "To: $RECIPIENT"
        echo "Subject: $SUBJECT"
        echo "MIME-Version: 1.0"
        echo "Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=\"BOUNDARY\""
        echo ""
        echo "--BOUNDARY"
        echo "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8"
        echo ""
        echo -e "$BODY"
        echo ""
        echo "--BOUNDARY"
        echo "Content-Type: application/pdf; name=\"$(basename "$PDF_FILE")\""
        echo "Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=\"$(basename "$PDF_FILE")\""
        echo "Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64"
        echo ""
        base64 "$PDF_FILE"
        echo ""
        echo "--BOUNDARY--"
    } | msmtp "$RECIPIENT"
elif command -v sendmail &>/dev/null; then
    {
        echo "To: $RECIPIENT"
        echo "Subject: $SUBJECT"
        echo "MIME-Version: 1.0"
        echo "Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=\"BOUNDARY\""
        echo ""
        echo "--BOUNDARY"
        echo "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8"
        echo ""
        echo -e "$BODY"
        echo ""
        echo "--BOUNDARY"
        echo "Content-Type: application/pdf; name=\"$(basename "$PDF_FILE")\""
        echo "Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=\"$(basename "$PDF_FILE")\""
        echo "Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64"
        echo ""
        base64 "$PDF_FILE"
        echo ""
        echo "--BOUNDARY--"
    } | sendmail -t
else
    echo "Error: No mail client found. Install mutt, mailutils, msmtp, or sendmail." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Email sent to $RECIPIENT."
